title: Owned MC: effect of changing a in a(x − h)^2 + k
stem_student: Compared with y = x^2, what does the parameter a do in f(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k when a = −2? A) Translates the graph 2 units left. B) Translates the graph 2 units down. C) Reflects the graph in the x-axis and stretches it vertically by a factor of 2. D) Compresses the graph horizontally by a factor of 2.
stem_teacher: LLOVES-owned MC for A2.5 roles of a (reflection + vertical stretch). Not Ministry wording.
answer_verification: a < 0 reflects in the x-axis; |a| = 2 is a vertical stretch by 2.
